definitions.explanation: To a high degree; a bookish or old-fashioned word for "very." In conversation it now sounds deliberately quaint and is often used playfully, as in すこぶる{元気|げんき} (in tip-top shape). Sometimes written {頗|すこぶ}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すこぶる⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather is in excellent health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すこぶる⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The manager is in a remarkably good mood today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}い{勝手|がって}→使い勝手：14983_tsukaigatte⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すこぶる⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The new system is extremely awkward to use, and staff on the ground are complaining.

notes:
It modifies adjectives and a few state expressions (⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧, ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧), not verbs of action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すこぶる⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: in fine fettle
- すこぶる⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: very well spoken of
- すこぶる{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: exceptional, of the first order (すこぶる{付|つ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very; the everyday word
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: extremely; formal but not old-fashioned
- ⟦{甚|はなは}だ→甚だ：10488_hanahada⟧: exceedingly; also bookish, mostly with negative words
